text: One tailed beast bump can level an entire mountain, so what happens if one hits a real city? It's a sphere of compressed chakra that explodes on impact and tailed beast have used it to flatten mountains and leave craters behind. The Burj Khalifa is 828 meters tall. Mount Fuji is 3,776 meters. If one blast can erase a mountain, skyline buildings would be vaporized. All skyscrapers and bridges would be gone, leaving just a crater where downtown used to be. So what a real city survived, only if the tailed beast uses not to fire.
